notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
That’s right, we finally have a release date, and it’s only a month away! 

We would never be able to get to this point without your help, so thank you once again from the Caligari Games team for your patience and support. 

Take a look at the brand new trailer we prepared for this amazing occasion. All your likes and comments will help us tremendously! 

[previewyoutube=AeMNuysHYis;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 0.16.1 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37669020/12690069b54d9654a023ec82739944e525e9c286.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

We hope that you're enjoying the Prologue so far! It has come to our attention that some players encountered a bug that prevented the game from starting. Good news is, we fixed it! So, if you had any troubles with that, everything has to run smoothly now.

Also, let us take this opportunity to remind you that you can make bug reports on our [url=https://discord.gg/hBdnAH5]Discord server[/url] or via support@caligarigames.com.
